description: List open times on Upforge's calendar for a free consultation (usually 30 minutes), in the person's own timezone. Call this before book_consultation and let the person pick a time; never pick one for them. Meeting types come live from the scheduler: general-inquiry is the default, and service types such as web-design, application-development or ai-automation route to the right person. Bookings need about a day's notice, so the search starts tomorrow.

address.description: Only for format client_location: where to meet. All five fields are required.

days.description: How many days to search from startDate (default 5).

format.description: virtual (a video call, the default), office (at Upforge's downtown Cincinnati office), or client_location (Upforge travels to them; needs an address and a phone number, and is limited to its travel area).

meetingType.description: Meeting type slug. Omit for general-inquiry. An unknown slug returns the list of available ones.

startDate.description: First day to search, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to tomorrow.

timezone.description: The person's IANA timezone, e.g. America/Chicago. Defaults to America/New_York.

name: find_consultation_times
title: Find open consultation times
